# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Roche reports 7% (CER) sales for the full year results in 2025. Commenting on the results, CEO

operational and R&D excellence.”

## We are Roche

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

[Man holding a surfing board smiling with a ocean in the background.]

## Our mission in action

[
[Two colleagues sit on a green couch in a modern office, engaged in conversation. One person
gestures while speaking, and the other listens attentively with a slight smile.]
Prevent

### Identifying high-risk patients

We prevent diseases by identifying high-risk patients early to enable timely use of medicines.

Our strategy
][110]
[
[A laboratory scientist wearing safety glasses and gloves looks into a microscope while conducting
research in a lab setting.]
Stop

### Halting disease progression

We stop disease progression by accurately diagnosing patients and delivering targeted medicines.

Our diagnostics solutions

[
[A laboratory professional wearing glasses and gloves explains a piece of equipment to a colleague
while holding its open lid in a lab setting.]
Cure

### Restoring health through medicines

We cure diseases by identifying the cause of a patient’s condition and restoring health through
curative medicines.

Our pharma solutions

View all stories

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

# NHS website for England Find information and services to help you manage your health

## [Health A to Z][8]

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

## Featured
* ### [ Book a COVID-19 vaccination appointment ][22]
  
  If you're eligible for the spring COVID-19 vaccine, you can book a vaccination appointment now
* ### [ Get healthcare cover abroad with a UK GHIC or EHIC ][23]
  
  Get or renew your health insurance card to help you get healthcare in the EU and some other
  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

## More information and advice
* ## [Vaccinations][25]
  
  Information about vaccinations for babies, children and adults, including why they're important
  and how to get them
* ## [COVID-19][26]
  
  Advice about COVID-19, including symptoms, treatments and how to avoid catching and spreading it.
* ## [Baby][27]
  
  A guide to everything you need to know about caring for a baby
* ## [Women's health][28]
  
  Information and support on health, wellbeing, conditions and screening
* ## [Contraception][29]

  work

# NHS website for England Find information and services to help you manage your health

## [Health A to Z][8]

Find out about conditions, symptoms, medicines, tests and treatments, including when to get help

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

## Featured
* ### [ Book a COVID-19 vaccination appointment ][22]
  
  If you're eligible for the spring COVID-19 vaccine, you can book a vaccination appointment now
* ### [ Get healthcare cover abroad with a UK GHIC or EHIC ][23]
  
  Get or renew your health insurance card to help you get healthcare in the EU and some other
  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

Cancer Healer Therapy is designed to work in synergy with the body's natural defences. It focuses

We’re the world’s leading cancer charity, dedicated to saving and improving lives with our research.

## Ways to support our vital research

We carry out research into more than 200 types of cancer. Whether you donate, fundraise or
volunteer, every effort supports life-saving research.

[
[A photo of a person wearing a Cancer Research UK t-shirt.]

Fundraise, leave a gift in your will or take part in an event - just some of the ways you can
support us.

][41][
[A photo of a Cancer Research UK volunteer showing the way to a runner.]

### Volunteer with us

Meet new people, develop your skills, and help change lives. Our volunteers make progress possible.

][42][
[A photo of Cancer Research UK fundraisers getting ready for a food sale.]

### Do your own fundraising

From bake sales to bingo, fundraise your way. We’ve got lots of resources to help you.

**New CholangioPath App**

#### Providing hope for improved treatments and outcomes, for those affected by cholangiocarcinoma,
#### also known as bile duct cancer.

##### WHO WE ARE

## The Cholangiocarcinoma Foundation (CCF)

is a global organization dedicated to curing cholangiocarcinoma (bile duct cancer) and enhancing
patients’ quality of life. Through innovative methodologies, partnerships, and support programs, CCF
connects patients and caregivers to resources, mentors, and support groups, while also fostering
scientific discovery through an annual research fellowship program.

[LEARN MORE][140]
[Stacie representing the Cholangiocarcinoma Foundation and bile duct cancer research.]

##### OUR CORE VALUES

## Our Core Values and Commitment to Patients

###### PATIENTS FIRST

We always put patients first. Our goal is to improve their treatment options and find a cure for
bile duct cancer.

[with the Cholangiocarcinoma Foundation, you are not alone in your bile duct cancer diagnosis]

###### COLLABORATION

We lead collaborative efforts, bringing scientists, clinicians, and healthcare providers together to
share research, resources, and funding.

###### INNOVATION

We provide vital resources, education, and support to cholangiocarcinoma patients and their
families.

###### URGENCY

We urgently improve methodologies, technologies, and partnerships to energize and drive our
programs, research, and funding strategies.

##### NEWLY DIAGNOSED?

### You are not alone.

Whether you’re newly diagnosed with bile duct cancer or new to CCF, we are here to help you on every
step of your journey. Join our Newly Connected program to join a support community, start with a
free care kit, and receive important information you’ll need for your cholangiocarcinoma journey.

Why choose usWhy choose us

#### Delivering global standards of clinical excellence

Our commitment to delivering high-quality care inspires our everyday decision making. Our team
adheres to international and national protocols and policies, including those adapted from the UK’s
NHS guidelines to ensure clinically reliable and safe healthcare delivery. Our team of clinicians
include those who are nationally and internationally recognised and considered as leaders in their
field.

#### Integrity in healthcare delivery

We partner with you to consistently maintain integrity in healthcare delivery across our services.
Our care team and support staff provide compassionate care with the purpose of bringing transparency
into your healthcare plan.

#### A promise of trust, empathy & continuity of care

Our patients are at the heart of what we do. Our caregivers are always willing to go the extra mile
for you and promote trust by upholding ethical behaviour in all our actions. We offer professional,
compassionate care delivered with warmth, responsiveness and sensitivity.

Why choose usWhy choose us

#### Delivering global standards of clinical excellence

Our commitment to delivering high-quality care inspires our everyday decision making. Our team
adheres to international and national protocols and policies, including those adapted from the UK’s
NHS guidelines to ensure clinically reliable and safe healthcare delivery. Our team of clinicians
include those who are nationally and internationally recognised and considered as leaders in their
field.

#### Integrity in healthcare delivery

We partner with you to consistently maintain integrity in healthcare delivery across our services.
Our care team and support staff provide compassionate care with the purpose of bringing transparency
into your healthcare plan.

#### A promise of trust, empathy & continuity of care

Our patients are at the heart of what we do. Our caregivers are always willing to go the extra mile
for you and promote trust by upholding ethical behaviour in all our actions. We offer professional,
compassionate care delivered with warmth, responsiveness and sensitivity.

urged my husband, who suffered for years with a bad foot injury, to try the device, and it
surprisingly worked for him, too. Since then we have used the Delta Laser, and now the CoMra Palm,

us feel better. I recommend and share the CoMra Palm with everyone I meet because it relieves them
in a matter of minutes, too. Their habit to take pain medication right away is something we have
avoided all of these years, and that's fine by me.

## Why Choose Us?

At Ganesh diagnostic, we offer multiple services to our patients at affordable prices because your
health is our first priority. We have a skillful and talented team associated with us to deliver the
best to our clients.

A free 24/7 ambulance service is also available to avoid havoc in emergency situations. We have
updated technologies to generate **100% accurate reports** for every test and check-up. We are an
organization that has been trusted by 30,000+ doctors. Active in the business for quite some time.

Back in 2001, famed radiologist Dr. Ravin Sharma laid the foundations of this organization after his
father, Ganesh Chand Sharma. From humble beginnings, our growth and expansion have become a
significant ride of many things. Today, we are considered one of the **best diagnostic centres and
[pathology][116] labs across Delhi**, robust problem solvers, and highly efficient in all areas.

**Ganesh Diagnostic** and Imaging Centre Pvt. Ltd. has been active in the **Diagnostic and
Pathology** Service sector for quite some time, Back in 2001, Famed Radiologist Dr. Ravin Sharma
laid the foundation of this organization with his father, Renowned Radiologist, Dr. Ganesh Chandra
Sharma. From humble beginnings, our growth and expansion have become a significant ride of many
things. Now, we are seen as one of the **Best Diagnostic and Pathology** services providers around
**Delhi**, resolving issues and problems in a robust and highly effective way all across the
board. At our Delhi-based diagnostic centres, we provide an array of services including *[blood
tests][117], [X-rays][118], [ultrasounds][119], [CT scans][120], [MRI scans][121]*, etc. We also

### Hirschfeld Oncology is redefining cancer care—combining standard therapies with innovative
### strategies, a trusted medical team, and unwavering advocacy to bring renewed hope.

At Hirschfeld Oncology, exceptional care is never the work of one person — it’s the strength of a
dedicated team.
Led by [**Dr. Azriel Hirschfeld**][27], our physicians, nurses, and medical staff work together to
design treatment plans grounded in science, compassion, and experience. Each team member plays a
vital role — guiding patients through every step and ensuring care that’s coordinated, precise, and
hopeful.

Low-Dose Multi-Drug Combinations

By combining chemotherapy drugs at lower doses, Dr. Hirschfeld reduces side effects while maximizing
the synergy between medicines to fight cancers more effectively.

Standard of Care—With an Expanded Therapeutic Lens

Our foundation is standard-of-care chemotherapy, guided by well-established clinical evidence and
outcomes data.Where appropriate, we build upon this foundation by integrating targeted therapies and
refined dosing strategies to enhance effectiveness while maintaining tolerability.

Beyond Institutional Treatment Constraints

Because we are not limited by large-institution protocols, we can thoughtfully apply emerging Phase
II clinical data and evolving treatment strategies—when supported by science—to offer options beyond
conventional care pathways.

Genomic profiling

Each tumor’s unique genetic profile is analyzed, allowing therapies to be precisely matched to the
cancer’s biology for greater accuracy and impact.

Data-Driven Off-Label Use

When evidence strongly supports benefit, FDA-approved drugs are used off-label, giving patients
earlier access to promising treatments beyond standard protocols.

## Beyond Standard Cancer Care

With over **20 years of oncology experience****,** Dr. Hirschfeld combines deep clinical expertise
with **hands-on practice in treating aggressive,** resistant cancers. Supported by a **skilled team,
dedicated staff,** and **affiliation with a larger medical system**, he offers care that goes far

conventional care pathways.

cancer’s biology for greater accuracy and impact.

earlier access to promising treatments beyond standard protocols.

## Important Safety Information

### What is the most important information I should know about IMFINZI^{®} (durvalumab) and
### IMJUDO^{®} (tremelimumab-actl)?

IMFINZI and IMJUDO are medicines that may treat certain cancers by working with your immune system.
IMFINZI and IMJUDO can cause your immune system to attack normal organs and tissues in any area of
your body and can affect the way they work. These problems can sometimes become severe or
life-threatening and can lead to death. You can have more than one of these problems at the same
time. These problems may happen anytime during treatment or even after your treatment has ended.

## What are IMFINZI and IMJUDO?

IMFINZI and IMJUDO are prescription medications that may treat certain cancers.

IMFINZI is used to treat adults with a type of lung cancer called NSCLC.
* IMFINZI may be used alone when your NSCLC has not spread outside your chest, cannot be removed by
  surgery, and has responded or stabilized with initial treatment with chemotherapy that contains
  platinum, given at the same time as radiation therapy.
* IMFINZI may be used in combination with chemotherapy that contains platinum prior to surgery and
  alone after surgery when your NSCLC is able to be removed by surgery, and your tumor does not have
  an abnormal “EGFR” or “ALK” gene.
* IMFINZI may be used in combination with IMJUDO and chemotherapy that contains platinum when your
  NSCLC has spread to other parts of your body (metastatic) and your tumor does not have an abnormal
  “EGFR” or “ALK” gene.

IMFINZI is used to treat adults with a type of lung cancer called SCLC.
* IMFINZI may be used alone when your LS-SCLC cannot be removed by surgery and has responded or
  stabilized after initial treatment with chemotherapy that contains platinum, given at the same
  time as radiation therapy.
* IMFINZI may be used with the chemotherapy medicines etoposide and either carboplatin or cisplatin
  as your first treatment when your SCLC has spread within your lungs or to other parts of the body
  (extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, or ES-SCLC).

IMFINZI is used in combination with chemotherapy medicines gemcitabine and cisplatin to treat adults
with a type of cancer called BTC, including cancer of the bile ducts (cholangiocarcinoma) and
gallbladder cancer, when your BTC has spread to nearby tissues (locally advanced), or has spread to
other parts of the body (metastatic).

IMFINZI is used in combination with IMJUDO to treat adults with a type of liver cancer that cannot
be removed by surgery (unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma or uHCC).

IMFINZI is used in combination with the chemotherapy medicines carboplatin and paclitaxel followed
by IMFINZI alone to treat adults with a type of uterine cancer called endometrial cancer that has
spread (advanced) or has come back (recurred), and a laboratory test shows that your tumor is
mismatch repair deficient (dMMR).

IMFINZI is used in combination with Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) to treat a type of bladder cancer
called high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) that has not spread into the muscle
layer of the bladder, when you have not had prior treatment with BCG.

IMFINZI may be used in combination with the chemotherapy medicines gemcitabine and cisplatin
(neoadjuvant treatment) prior to surgical removal of your bladder followed by IMFINZI alone after
surgery (adjuvant treatment) to treat a type of bladder cancer called muscle- invasive bladder
cancer (MIBC) that has spread into the muscle layer of the bladder but not to other parts of the
body.

IMFINZI is used in combination with FLOT prior to and after surgery followed by IMFINZI alone to
treat adults with a type of stomach cancer called gastric cancer (GC) or gastroesophageal junction
adenocarcinoma (GEJC) that can be removed by surgery.

It is not known if IMFINZI and IMJUDO are safe and effective in children.

### Call or see your healthcare provider right away if you develop any new or worsening signs or
### symptoms, including:
* [Red Lung Problems Icon]
  
  Lung problems: cough, shortness of breath, and chest pain
* [Red Intestinal Problems Icon]
  
  Intestinal problems: diarrhea (loose stools) or more frequent bowel movements than usual; stools
  that are black, tarry, sticky, or have blood or mucus; and severe stomach-area (abdomen) pain or
  tenderness
* [Red Liver Problems Icon]
  
  Liver problems: yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes, severe nausea or vomiting, pain
  on the right side of your stomach area (abdomen), dark urine (tea colored), and bleeding or
  bruising more easily than normal
* [Red Hormone Gland Problems Icon]
  
  Hormone gland problems: headaches that will not go away or unusual headaches; eye sensitivity to
  light; eye problems; rapid heartbeat; increased sweating; extreme tiredness; weight gain or weight
  loss; feeling more hungry or thirsty than usual; urinating more often than usual; hair loss;
  feeling cold; constipation; your voice gets deeper; dizziness or fainting; and changes in mood or
  behavior, such as decreased sex drive, irritability, or forgetfulness
* [Red Kidney Problems Icon]
  
  Kidney problems: decrease in your amount of urine, blood in your urine, swelling of your ankles,
  and loss of appetite
* [Red Skin Problems Icon]
  
  Skin problems: rash; itching; skin blistering or peeling; painful sores or ulcers in mouth or
  nose, throat, or genital area; fever or flu-like symptoms; and swollen lymph nodes
* [Red Pancreas Problems Icon]
  
  Pancreas problems: pain in your upper stomach area (abdomen), severe nausea or vomiting, and loss
  of appetite
* [Red Other Organ Problems Icon]
  
  Problems can also happen in other organs and tissues. These are not all of the signs and symptoms
  of immune system problems that can happen with IMFINZI and IMJUDO. Call or see your healthcare
  provider right away for any new or worsening signs or symptoms, which may include: Chest pain,
  irregular heartbeats, shortness of breath or swelling of ankles; confusion, sleepiness, memory
  problems, changes in mood or behavior, stiff neck, balance problems; tingling, numbness or
  weakness of the arms or legs; double vision, blurry vision, sensitivity to light, eye pain,
  changes in eye sight; persistent or severe muscle pain or weakness, muscle cramps, joint pain,
  joint stiffness or swelling; and low red blood cells and bruising
* [Red Severe Infusion Reactions Icon]
  
  Infusion reactions that can sometimes be severe or life-threatening. Signs and symptoms of
  infusion reactions may include: chills or shaking, itching or rash, flushing, shortness of breath
  or wheezing, dizziness, feel like passing out, fever, and back or neck pain
* [Rejection of a Transplanted Organ or Tissue Icon]
  
  Rejection of a transplanted organ or tissue. Your healthcare provider should tell you what signs
  and symptoms you should report and monitor you depending on the type of organ or tissue transplant

* IMFINZI may be used alone when your NSCLC has not spread outside your chest, cannot be removed by
  surgery, and has responded or stabilized with initial treatment with chemotherapy that contains
  platinum, given at the same time as radiation therapy.
* IMFINZI may be used in combination with chemotherapy that contains platinum prior to surgery and
  alone after surgery when your NSCLC is able to be removed by surgery, and your tumor does not have
  an abnormal “EGFR” or “ALK” gene.
* IMFINZI may be used in combination with IMJUDO and chemotherapy that contains platinum when your
  NSCLC has spread to other parts of your body (metastatic) and your tumor does not have an abnormal
  “EGFR” or “ALK” gene.

IMFINZI is used to treat adults with a type of lung cancer called SCLC.
* IMFINZI may be used alone when your LS-SCLC cannot be removed by surgery and has responded or
  stabilized after initial treatment with chemotherapy that contains platinum, given at the same
  time as radiation therapy.
* IMFINZI may be used with the chemotherapy medicines etoposide and either carboplatin or cisplatin
  as your first treatment when your SCLC has spread within your lungs or to other parts of the body
  (extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, or ES-SCLC).

IMFINZI is used in combination with chemotherapy medicines gemcitabine and cisplatin to treat adults
with a type of cancer called BTC, including cancer of the bile ducts (cholangiocarcinoma) and
gallbladder cancer, when your BTC has spread to nearby tissues (locally advanced), or has spread to
other parts of the body (metastatic).

IMFINZI is used in combination with IMJUDO to treat adults with a type of liver cancer that cannot
be removed by surgery (unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma or uHCC).

IMFINZI is used in combination with the chemotherapy medicines carboplatin and paclitaxel followed
by IMFINZI alone to treat adults with a type of uterine cancer called endometrial cancer that has
spread (advanced) or has come back (recurred), and a laboratory test shows that your tumor is
mismatch repair deficient (dMMR).

IMFINZI is used in combination with FLOT prior to and after surgery followed by IMFINZI alone to
treat adults with a type of stomach cancer called gastric cancer (GC) or gastroesophageal junction
adenocarcinoma (GEJC) that can be removed by surgery.

It is not known if IMFINZI and IMJUDO are safe and effective in children.

## Indication and Important Safety Information

### What is IQIRVO^{®} used for?

IQIRVO is a prescription medicine used to treat primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) in combination
with ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) in adults who have not responded well to UDCA, or used alone in
patients unable to tolerate UDCA.

IQIRVO is not recommended for use in people who have symptoms or signs of advanced liver disease. It
is not known if taking IQIRVO will improve your chance of survival or prevent liver decompensation.

It is not known if IQIRVO is safe and effective in children under 18 years of age.

### What Warnings should I know about IQIRVO?
* IQIRVO can cause muscle problems (myalgia, myopathy, rhabdomyolysis) and muscle pain that can be
  severe. Treatment with IQIRVO may cause muscle pain or worsen existing pain and can increase the
  level of an enzyme in your blood called creatine phosphokinase (CPK); both can be a sign of muscle
  damage. If there is new or worsening muscle pain, your healthcare provider may examine you and
  perform a blood test. Stop taking IQIRVO and call your healthcare provider right away if you have
  any of the following signs or symptoms: severe muscle pain, unexplained soreness, unexplained
  muscle weakness, or dark, reddish urine.
* IQIRVO may increase the risk of bone fractures. Tell your healthcare provider about any bone
  fractures, or if you develop pain, or have changes in your ability to move around.
* IQIRVO may cause harm to an unborn baby when taken during pregnancy. Women taking IQIRVO who can
  become pregnant should use effective birth control during treatment and for 3 weeks after the last
  dose of IQIRVO. Talk to your healthcare provider about birth control methods that may be right for
  you. Tell your healthcare provider right away if you become pregnant or think you may be pregnant.
* IQIRVO can cause liver problems and abnormal liver blood test results. Your healthcare provider
  should do tests before starting and during treatment with IQIRVO to check your liver function.
  Tell your healthcare provider right away if you experience any of the following during treatment
  with IQIRVO: swelling of your stomach-area (abdomen), yellowing of your skin or whites of your
  eyes, black, tarry, or bloody stools, mental changes such as confusion, being sleepier than usual
  or harder to wake up, slurred speech, mood swings, or changes in personality, or coughing up or
  vomiting blood, or your vomit looks like coffee grounds. If you have severe stomach-area (abdomen)
  pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite or weight loss, new or worsening fatigue,
  weakness, fever and chills, light-headedness, or less frequent urination, tell your healthcare
  provider right away.
* Some people taking IQIRVO had allergic reactions, which may include rash, trouble breathing,
  itching, or swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat. If you experience any of these, stop
  taking IQIRVO, call your healthcare provider right away or go to the nearest hospital emergency
  room.
* IQIRVO can cause blockage of the bile duct and may increase your risk of gallstones. Call your
  healthcare provider right away if you develop pain in the upper right stomach area or yellowing of
  the skin.

### You should not use IQIRVO if you:
* Have advanced liver disease.
* Are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. IQIRVO can harm your unborn baby. You should not become
  pregnant during treatment with IQIRVO.
* Are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. It is not known if IQIRVO passes into your breast milk.
  Talk with your healthcare provider about the best way to feed your baby if you take IQIRVO.

### What are the side effects of IQIRVO?

The most common side effects of IQIRVO include weight gain, diarrhea, stomach pain, nausea,
vomiting, joint pain, constipation, muscle pain, bone fractures, gastroesophageal reflux disease
(GERD), dry mouth, weight loss, and rash. These are not all of the possible side effects of IQIRVO.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.

### What other medications might interact with IQIRVO?

Tell your healthcare provider about all of the medicines you take, including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements. IQIRVO can affect the way certain
medicines work. Certain medicines may affect the way IQIRVO works. If you take a bile acid binding
resin, take IQIRVO at least 4 hours before or after you take your bile acid resin.

You are encouraged to report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088 or at [www.fda.gov/medwatch][68].
You may also report side effects to Ipsen Biopharmaceuticals, Inc. at 1-855-463-5127.

## Indication and Important Safety Information

### What is IQIRVO^{®} used for?

IQIRVO is a prescription medicine used to treat primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) in combination
with ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) in adults who have not responded well to UDCA, or used alone in
patients unable to tolerate UDCA.

IQIRVO is not recommended for use in people who have symptoms or signs of advanced liver disease. It
is not known if taking IQIRVO will improve your chance of survival or prevent liver decompensation.

It is not known if IQIRVO is safe and effective in children under 18 years of age.

### What Warnings should I know about IQIRVO?
* IQIRVO can cause muscle problems (myalgia, myopathy, rhabdomyolysis) and muscle pain that can be
  severe. Treatment with IQIRVO may cause muscle pain or worsen existing pain and can increase the
  level of an enzyme in your blood called creatine phosphokinase (CPK); both can be a sign of muscle
  damage. If there is new or worsening muscle pain, your healthcare provider may examine you and
  perform a blood test. Stop taking IQIRVO and call your healthcare provider right away if you have
  any of the following signs or symptoms: severe muscle pain, unexplained soreness, unexplained
  muscle weakness, or dark, reddish urine.
* IQIRVO may increase the risk of bone fractures. Tell your healthcare provider about any bone
  fractures, or if you develop pain, or have changes in your ability to move around.
* IQIRVO may cause harm to an unborn baby when taken during pregnancy. Women taking IQIRVO who can
  become pregnant should use effective birth control during treatment and for 3 weeks after the last
  dose of IQIRVO. Talk to your healthcare provider about birth control methods that may be right for
  you. Tell your healthcare provider right away if you become pregnant or think you may be pregnant.
* IQIRVO can cause liver problems and abnormal liver blood test results. Your healthcare provider
  should do tests before starting and during treatment with IQIRVO to check your liver function.
  Tell your healthcare provider right away if you experience any of the following during treatment
  with IQIRVO: swelling of your stomach-area (abdomen), yellowing of your skin or whites of your
  eyes, black, tarry, or bloody stools, mental changes such as confusion, being sleepier than usual
  or harder to wake up, slurred speech, mood swings, or changes in personality, or coughing up or
  vomiting blood, or your vomit looks like coffee grounds. If you have severe stomach-area (abdomen)
  pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite or weight loss, new or worsening fatigue,
  weakness, fever and chills, light-headedness, or less frequent urination, tell your healthcare
  provider right away.
* Some people taking IQIRVO had allergic reactions, which may include rash, trouble breathing,
  itching, or swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat. If you experience any of these, stop
  taking IQIRVO, call your healthcare provider right away or go to the nearest hospital emergency
  room.
* IQIRVO can cause blockage of the bile duct and may increase your risk of gallstones. Call your
  healthcare provider right away if you develop pain in the upper right stomach area or yellowing of
  the skin.

### You should not use IQIRVO if you:
* Have advanced liver disease.
* Are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. IQIRVO can harm your unborn baby. You should not become
  pregnant during treatment with IQIRVO.
* Are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. It is not known if IQIRVO passes into your breast milk.
  Talk with your healthcare provider about the best way to feed your baby if you take IQIRVO.

### What are the side effects of IQIRVO?

The most common side effects of IQIRVO include weight gain, diarrhea, stomach pain, nausea,
vomiting, joint pain, constipation, muscle pain, bone fractures, gastroesophageal reflux disease
(GERD), dry mouth, weight loss, and rash. These are not all of the possible side effects of IQIRVO.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.

### What other medications might interact with IQIRVO?

Tell your healthcare provider about all of the medicines you take, including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements. IQIRVO can affect the way certain
medicines work. Certain medicines may affect the way IQIRVO works. If you take a bile acid binding
resin, take IQIRVO at least 4 hours before or after you take your bile acid resin.

You are encouraged to report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088 or at [www.fda.gov/medwatch][68].
You may also report side effects to Ipsen Biopharmaceuticals, Inc. at 1-855-463-5127.

Please see full [Prescribing Information][69].

of liver diseases][38] at the initial stage so that patients can be provided with the necessary

Leaders in Liver Health is a reliable **liver health clinic in London** where we specialise in

## Specialist Liver Health Assessment in London

**Liver health assessment in London** is aimed at preventing the occurrence of late liver disease
and identifying the risk factors that may lead to serious liver damage. Our team of clinical
specialists and modern l**iver disease screening** devices will assess your liver health
exhaustively.

**When would you see a liver specialist?** A specialist should be considered in case of an
**abnormal liver blood test,** a possible **fatty liver diagnosis,** or symptoms related to
[alcohol-related liver damage][41], or chronic digestive discomfort and tiredness. These are
symptoms that can indicate internal liver problems that require professional examination.

In the course of your evaluation, we examine medical history, lifestyle, and diagnostic outcomes to
establish the possible causes of liver dysfunction. Early identification will enable our team to
identify issues at an earlier stage and give expert advice on appropriate actions to take.

## Our Diagnostic Services of the Liver

Our clinic is focused on the overall [**liver diagnostic tests in London,**][42] which are aimed at
the evaluation of liver functioning and the identification of possible disease at an initial stage.
These services are aimed at assessment and diagnosis as opposed to treatment.

Leaders in Liver Health uses the most modern diagnostic tools to evaluate the health of the liver,
analyse laboratory outcomes, and measure risk factors. All the evaluations help us to define whether
we need to investigate further with a specialist. We aim to provide precise information about liver
functioning and detect abnormalities before they develop into severe illnesses.

### FibroScan Liver Scan

**FibroScan in London** is a **non-invasive liver scan,** which is used to measure the stiffness and
fat in the liver, and the service is available in London. It is a fast test that identifies fibrosis
and fatty liver disease without needles or surgical intervention. Get more information on our
special FibroScan page.

[Read More][43]

### Complete Liver Disease Evaluation

Leaders in Liver Health will evaluate liver and blood tests and analyse the risks. This helps to
detect possible liver disease and gives a better understanding of the general liver condition.

[Read More][44]

Patients can also be provided with specialist consultation with an experienced hepatology specialist
who examines diagnostic findings and provides professional interpretation and advice.

## What Is a FibroScan and Why Is It Important for Liver Health?

A **FibroScan scan in London** is a non-invasive liver scan, which measures the stiffness and the
level of fats in the liver to identify early liver disease. It allows doctors to detect liver damage
before the symptoms manifest and helps to monitor liver health in a safe and fast way.

FibroScan involves the use of high-end **liver elastography** technology to send mild vibrations to
the liver. These vibrations allow the device to carry out a **liver stiffness test,** which lets the
device know whether scar tissue or fibrosis is possible. At the same time, the scan determines the
level of fat in liver cells using a specialised **fatty liver scan** measurement.

The process is similar to an ultrasound, and it lasts about 10-15 minutes. The patients are lying
comfortably with a small probe resting on the skin in the area of the liver. The scan is not painful
and does not need any recovery.

FibroScan is increasingly being used by doctors as it is able to give reliable diagnostic
information in most cases without the possibility of invasive liver biopsy. This makes it a valuable
instrument for early diagnosis and tracking of liver diseases.

[ Book a Consultation ][47]

## Liver Diseases We Diagnose and Assess

Our clinic specialises in the diagnosis of **liver disease in London,** by thorough testing,
imaging, and expert assessment. Leaders in Liver Health aim at early detection of liver disorders in
order to provide patients with proper medical advice.

### Abnormal Liver Enzymes

Abnormal liver enzyme is a common finding in normal blood tests and can be an indication of
inflammation, infection, or liver damage. Our diagnostic analysis assists in the determination of
possible causes, including fatty liver disease, medication effects, viral infections or metabolic
disorders.

### Alcohol-Induced Liver Disease

The overconsumption of alcohol may lead to the destruction of liver cells and result in progressive
liver damage. Diagnostic tests aid in identifying the early liver inflammation, fatty alterations or
scarring that can arise with the continued exposure to alcohol.

### Gallstones and Biliary Disease

The gallbladder and bile ducts are part of digestion and are impacted by gallstones and biliary
conditions. Diagnostic scans diagnose obstruction, inflammation or abnormality in the biliary
system.

### Hemochromatosis and Hyperferritinemia

These diseases include the overabundance of iron in the body. The long term effects of iron overload
are that it can harm the liver tissue, and diagnostic tests are used to detect the presence of
abnormal iron levels and possible genetic factors.

### Liver Cirrhosis

Cirrhosis is a condition that is caused by the replacement of normal liver tissue by scar tissue.
The severity of scarring and the progression of the disease is identified through diagnostic imaging
and liver stiffness testing.

### Liver Cancer

Liver cancer is the unnatural increase of liver cells and can be identified by the use of imaging
scans, blood markers, and clinical assessment. Early identification is essential in the further
referral and care planning by the specialists.

### Liver Lesions

Liver lesions are growths that are abnormal and can be detected in the process of regular imaging
examination. They may be harmless or may need further examination based on their size, appearance,
and risks associated with the patient.

### Viral Hepatitis

A long-term inflammation of the liver may be caused by viruses e.g. hepatitis B and hepatitis C.
Diagnostic blood tests reveal the presence of infection and assess the degree of liver damage.

### Bile Duct Cancer and Gallbladder Cancer

Biliary tract cancers are able to disrupt bile flow and liver functioning. Imaging and specialized
diagnostic tests detect abnormality and inform the medical assessment.

## Who should Consider a Liver Health Check?

Our **liver health check in London** helps to diagnose hepatic disorders at an early stage even
before the symptoms appear.

**Who should consider a liver scan?** Patients who pose risk factors of liver disease or have
abnormal laboratory results should consider screening.

You can benefit by liver assessment in case you:
* Blood **abnormal liver enzymes.**
* Obese, diabetic or metabolic syndrome.
* At risk of fatty liver disease.
* Take alcohol frequently or excessively.
* Family history of liver disease.
* Have chronic fatigue or stomachache.
* Have already been diagnosed with fatty liver disease or alcoholic liver disease.

Frequent screening helps to identify hepatic conditions earlier and helps to monitor long-term
health better.

before the symptoms appear.

**Who should consider a liver scan?** Patients who pose risk factors of liver disease or have
abnormal laboratory results should consider screening.

You can benefit by liver assessment in case you:
* Blood **abnormal liver enzymes.**
* Obese, diabetic or metabolic syndrome.
* At risk of fatty liver disease.
* Take alcohol frequently or excessively.
* Family history of liver disease.
* Have chronic fatigue or stomachache.
* Have already been diagnosed with fatty liver disease or alcoholic liver disease.

Frequent screening helps to identify hepatic conditions earlier and helps to monitor long-term
health better.

##### How It Works

## Access Expert Liver Health Today
* ### Worried about your liver health?
  
  Have you had abnormal liver enzymes or abnormal scan result?
* ### [Contact Leaders in Liver Health][48]
  
  Arrange a consultation with one of our experts and access world class healthcare.
* ### In-Person & Virtual Consultation
  
  You will be contacted by a member of the team within 24hours to arrange an in-person & virtual
  consultation with a dedicated liver specialist.
* ### Liver Assessment
  
  We will undertake appropriate investigations to assess your liver health and establish a
  diagnosis.
* ### Personalised Plan
  
  You may be required to attend for further tests in order to formulate a personalised management
  plan.

## Why Choose Leaders in Liver Health in London

Leaders in Liver Health provide accurate liver tests and expert advice. Our **liver specialist
clinic in London** is a modern clinic that incorporates the latest diagnostic technology and
professional clinical care.

The patients enjoy the services of experienced liver specialists and a network of reputable
hepatologists in London who understand the complexity of liver disease. Being one of the most
successful private liver clinics in London, we focus on delivering straightforward diagnostic
information and individual evaluation.

The benefits of our clinic are:
* Specialists and experts in hepatology and liver.
* New diagnostic equipment, such as FibroScan.
* Customised liver health analysis.
* Central clinic in London.
* Rapid availability of diagnostic outcomes.
Our team works in close cooperation with patients in order to detect possible liver conditions as
early as possible and provide them with specialist advice on further actions.

### [ CendR Platform® Technology ][57]

The CendR Platform® incorporates novel technologies to enable more effective tumor-targeted, tissue
penetrating delivery of anti-cancer drugs to solid tumors. The Platform can also target
non-cancerous, immunosuppressive cells selectively within the tumor to enable a patient’s immune
system and/or immunotherapies to fight cancer more effectively.

# Targeted Therapy Delivered

Lisata Therapeutics is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company developing innovative therapies based
on clear differentiation and rigorous data applied in areas of high unmet medical need.

[Learn more about our approach][56]
[ ]
[ ]

### [ CendR Platform® Technology ][57]

The CendR Platform® incorporates novel technologies to enable more effective tumor-targeted, tissue
penetrating delivery of anti-cancer drugs to solid tumors. The Platform can also target
non-cancerous, immunosuppressive cells selectively within the tumor to enable a patient’s immune
system and/or immunotherapies to fight cancer more effectively.

Learn more about the CendR Platform®
[ ]

## Spotlight

On an episode of the WTR Healthcare Spotlight podcast, Lisata’s President & CEO, David J. Mazzo,
PhD, and CMO, Kristen K. Buck, MD, discuss certepetide—Lisata’s novel tumor-penetrating therapy—and
encouraging preliminary Phase 2b results in metastatic pancreatic cancer.

[Listen now][58]
[Cell therapy scientist looking through a microscope]

## Broad, Clinical-Stage Pipeline

We aim to transform patient lives through the development of unique therapies targeting cancer and
other serious diseases.

[Explore our pipeline][59]

## Join Our Team

Our mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for the treatment of advanced
solid tumors and other major diseases. We can accomplish that goal through the collective efforts of
talented individuals who work together to advance scientific research. We place a premium on
integrity, respect, diversity, and collaboration. These values have helped us to build a growing
company that offers professionally rewarding careers with the opportunity to make a meaningful
contribution to patients in need.

## Liver Transplant Surgeon in Pune - Dr. Manoj Dongare

[Dr. Manoj Dongare]

Dr. Manoj Dongare is one of the best **Liver Transplant surgeon **and **[HPB surgeon in PCMC][53]
and Pune**. He has more than 17+ years of experience in the field of Liver transplants, HPB
Surgeries, and surgical oncology. He is currently working as a senior consultant in the Department
of HPB and Liver Transplant at D.Y. Patil Medical College, Hospital & Research Centre, Pimpri, Pune.

Dr. Manoj Dongare, In his clinical experience, performs adult and Paediatric Liver transplant
surgeries, and liver & HPB Pancreatic cancer surgeries**.** Also, He has expertise in various cancer
surgeries like breast, lung, Gynecological, bladder, oral, and GI cancers and making him one of the
**[best cancer specialist in PCMC][54], Pune. ** Also, He is also known as one of the very few GI &
HPB Surgical oncologists and liver transplant surgeon in Pune who has expertise in treating cancers.

Dr. Manoj Dongare has a Special Interest in Complex HPB Surgery, Cadaveric and Living Donar Liver
Transplantation, and Surgical Oncology. He has been actively involved in over 700 liver Transplants,
600 Pancreatic Resections (including portal vein resections, Post chemoradiation), and 500 liver
resections for colorectal metastasis and HCC’s, Extended hepatectomies +/- Vascular resections for
cholangiocarcinomas, 2 stage hepatectomies, and ALPPS.

Dr. Manoj Dongare has an active research interest he has many publications in reputed national and
international journals to his credit. He has presented his clinical and research work as papers and
posters in many conferences around the country and abroad. His expertise in organ transplant and
cancer surgery makes him one of the best Liver Transplant surgeon in Pune. His ongoing objective is
to reach out to underdeveloped areas of the country to spread awareness about cancer and its
treatment.

## INDICATIONS

## **WHAT IS LYTGOBI?**

LYTGOBI is a prescription medicine that is used to treat adults with bile duct cancer (intrahepatic
cholangiocarcinoma) that has spread or cannot be removed by surgery, who have already received a
previous treatment, and whose tumor has a certain type of abnormal “FGFR2” gene.

Your healthcare provider will test your cancer for a certain type of abnormal FGFR2 gene and make
sure that LYTGOBI is right for you.

It is not known if LYTGOBI is safe and effective in children.

LYTGOBI is approved based on tumor response and duration of response. There are ongoing studies to
show if LYTGOBI improves survival or symptoms.

## IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

## **IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION**

**LYTGOBI may cause serious side effects, including:**
* **Eye problems:** Certain eye problems are common with LYTGOBI but can also be serious. Eye
  problems include dry or inflamed eyes, inflamed cornea (front part of the eye), increased tears,
  and a disorder of the retina (an internal part of the eye). You will need to see an eye specialist
  for a complete eye exam before you begin treatment with LYTGOBI, every 2 months for the first 6
  months, and every 3 months thereafter during treatment with LYTGOBI.
  * **Tell your healthcare provider right away** if you develop any changes in your vision during
    treatment with LYTGOBI, including blurred vision, flashes of light, or seeing black spots. You
    may need to see an eye specialist right away.
  * You should use artificial tears or substitutes, or hydrating or lubricating eye gels during
    treatment with LYTGOBI to help prevent or treat dry eyes.
* **High phosphate levels in your blood (hyperphosphatemia) and buildup of minerals in different
  tissues in your body:** Hyperphosphatemia is common with LYTGOBI but can also be serious. High
  levels of phosphate in your blood may lead to buildup of minerals such as calcium in different
  tissues in your body. Your healthcare provider will check your blood phosphate levels during
  treatment with LYTGOBI.
  * Your healthcare provider may prescribe changes in your diet or phosphate-lowering therapy, or
    change, interrupt, or stop LYTGOBI if needed.
  * **Tell your healthcare provider right away** if you develop any muscle cramps, or numbness or
    tingling around your mouth.

**The most common side effects of LYTGOBI include:**
* changes in kidney function blood tests
* increased blood glucose level
* decreased red blood cell, white blood cell, and platelet counts
* increased calcium level in the blood
* decreased sodium and phosphate levels in the blood
* changes in liver function blood tests
* nails separate from the bed or poor formation of the nail; change in the color of nails
* muscle pain
* constipation
* diarrhea
* feeling tired or weak
* changes in tests used to measure your blood clotting time
* dry mouth
* hair loss
* decreased protein level (albumin) in the blood
* mouth sores
* stomach area (abdominal) pain
* dry skin
* decreased glucose and potassium level in the blood
* joint pain
* changes in sense of taste
* dry eye
* nausea
* decrease in appetite
* urinary tract infection
* redness, swelling, peeling or tenderness, mainly on the hands or feet (“hand-foot syndrome”)
* vomiting

These are not all the possible side effects of LYTGOBI. For more information, talk to your
healthcare provider or pharmacist. You may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.

**Before you take LYTGOBI, tell your healthcare provider about all of your medical conditions,
including if you:**
* have vision or eye problems.
* are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. LYTGOBI can harm your unborn baby or cause loss of your
  pregnancy (miscarriage). You should not become pregnant during treatment with LYTGOBI.
* **Females who can become pregnant:**
  * Your healthcare provider should do a pregnancy test before you start treatment with LYTGOBI.
  * You should use an effective method of birth control during treatment and for 1 week after your
    final dose of LYTGOBI. Talk to your healthcare provider about birth control methods that may be
    right for you.
  * Tell your healthcare provider right away if you become pregnant or think that you may be
    pregnant.
* **Males with female partners who can become pregnant:**
  * You should use effective birth control when sexually active during treatment with LYTGOBI and
    for 1 week after your last dose of LYTGOBI.
* are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. It is not known if LYTGOBI passes into your breast milk.
  Do not breastfeed during treatment and for 1 week after your last dose of LYTGOBI.

**Tell your healthcare provider about all the medicines you take,** including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements. LYTGOBI and other medicines may affect
each other causing side effects. LYTGOBI may affect the way other medicines work, and other
medicines may affect how LYTGOBI works.

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,
Whitefield Road, Hoodi Village, Bengaluru) , **Women and Children Hospital Bangalore**

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,

MEDIA RECOGNITION – OUTLOOK INDIA

## Dr. Deepak Chhabra FeaturedBest Doctors Mumbai 2026.

We are proud to announce that Dr. Deepak Chhabra has been featured in the prestigious "Best Doctors
Mumbai 2026" edition of Outlook India. The management of Lilavati Hospital and Research Centre
extended their heartfelt congratulations, recognizing his professional excellence and the respect he
commands within the medical fraternity. This feature highlights his specialized HPB training in
Japan, certified robotic training in South Korea, and his expertise in performing complex
Cytoreductive Surgeries and HIPEC.

[ View Magazine Feature ][64] [View Appreciation Letter][65]
Found a Lump or a Tumor

## Found a Tumor? What It Really Means.

Discovering a lump can be terrifying, but not every lump is cancer. In this clear and reassuring
guide, Dr. Deepak Chhabra breaks down the crucial difference between benign and malignant tumors and
debunks the common myths surrounding biopsies. His advice is simple: "Don't panic, but don't delay.

[ Know Your Doctor ][66] [Seek Help][67]
HEALTH AWARENESS – MEDIA FEATURE

## Risks of Surgery in Gastrointestinal Cancer.

Dr. Deepak Chhabra was featured in First Mumbai News to highlight the challenges and risks
associated with gastrointestinal cancer surgeries. He explained how surgeries on the stomach, colon,
liver, or pancreas can be complex but are often lifesaving, and emphasized the importance of patient
awareness and recovery support.

[ Know Your Doctor ][68] [Seek Help][69]
Health awareness – media feature

## Pancreatic Cancer The Silent Killer.

Dr. Deepak Chhabra, senior surgical oncologist, was recently featured in First Mumbai News where he
shared vital insights on Pancreatic Cancer, often called the "Silent Killer." In the article, he
explained the risks, warning signs, and importance of early detection for improving survival rates.

[ Know Your Doctor ][70] [Seek Help][71]
Leading cancer care

## Empowering Lives in the Fight Against Cancer.

Welcome to the forefront of compassionate healthcare. Dr. Deepak Chhabra, a distinguished **oncology
specialist in Mumbai**, brings over 20 years of experience to his practice. He has performed more
than 5,000 cancer surgeries, specializing in Hepato-Biliary and Pancreatic procedures. Dr. Chhabra's
dedication towards providing personalized cancer care ensures that each patient receives
personalized and comprehensive care.

[ Know Your Doctor ][72] [Seek Help][73]
Leading cancer care

## Where Hope Meets Healing Specialized Cancer Care.

Dedicated to guiding you through every step with expert care and compassion. From diagnosis to
treatment and beyond, we stand by your side. Together, we fight and heal.

[ Know Your Doctor ][74] [Seek Help][75]
Leading cancer care

## Experience Expert Care With Dr. Deepak Chhabra.

Cancer is a complex and multifaceted disease because of the uncontrolled growth and spread of
abnormal cells in the body. Together, we can turn the tide in the battle against cancer's impact.

## Dr. Deepak Chhabra FeaturedBest Doctors Mumbai 2026.

We are proud to announce that Dr. Deepak Chhabra has been featured in the prestigious "Best Doctors
Mumbai 2026" edition of Outlook India. The management of Lilavati Hospital and Research Centre
extended their heartfelt congratulations, recognizing his professional excellence and the respect he
commands within the medical fraternity. This feature highlights his specialized HPB training in
Japan, certified robotic training in South Korea, and his expertise in performing complex
Cytoreductive Surgeries and HIPEC.

[ View Magazine Feature ][64] [View Appreciation Letter][65]

## Found a Tumor? What It Really Means.

Discovering a lump can be terrifying, but not every lump is cancer. In this clear and reassuring
guide, Dr. Deepak Chhabra breaks down the crucial difference between benign and malignant tumors and
debunks the common myths surrounding biopsies. His advice is simple: "Don't panic, but don't delay.

## Risks of Surgery in Gastrointestinal Cancer.

Dr. Deepak Chhabra was featured in First Mumbai News to highlight the challenges and risks
associated with gastrointestinal cancer surgeries. He explained how surgeries on the stomach, colon,
liver, or pancreas can be complex but are often lifesaving, and emphasized the importance of patient
awareness and recovery support.

[ Know Your Doctor ][68] [Seek Help][69]
Health awareness – media feature

## Pancreatic Cancer The Silent Killer.

Dr. Deepak Chhabra, senior surgical oncologist, was recently featured in First Mumbai News where he
shared vital insights on Pancreatic Cancer, often called the "Silent Killer." In the article, he
explained the risks, warning signs, and importance of early detection for improving survival rates.

[ Know Your Doctor ][70] [Seek Help][71]
Leading cancer care

## Empowering Lives in the Fight Against Cancer.

Welcome to the forefront of compassionate healthcare. Dr. Deepak Chhabra, a distinguished **oncology
specialist in Mumbai**, brings over 20 years of experience to his practice. He has performed more
than 5,000 cancer surgeries, specializing in Hepato-Biliary and Pancreatic procedures. Dr. Chhabra's
dedication towards providing personalized cancer care ensures that each patient receives
personalized and comprehensive care.

Leading cancer care

## Where Hope Meets Healing Specialized Cancer Care.

Dedicated to guiding you through every step with expert care and compassion. From diagnosis to
treatment and beyond, we stand by your side. Together, we fight and heal.

[ Know Your Doctor ][74] [Seek Help][75]
Leading cancer care

## Experience Expert Care With Dr. Deepak Chhabra.

Cancer is a complex and multifaceted disease because of the uncontrolled growth and spread of
abnormal cells in the body. Together, we can turn the tide in the battle against cancer's impact.

# Better Health Starts Here

Ranked No. 1 for quality care in the U.S. four years in a row. Discover what makes us the better
health system.

  ## The Dream Team Behind the Microplastics Mystery
  
  Could microplastics leave a DNA signature that helps explain the rise of colorectal cancer in
  younger adults? NYU Langone scientists and clinicians widen the lens on one of cancer medicine's
  most urgent questions.
  
  Play Video play_arrow
* close
  
  ## NYU Langone Performs World’s 1st HIV-to-HIV Lung Transplant
  
  The surgery brings new hope for HIV-positive patients in need of lung transplants, as it opens a
  pool of potential donors who were previously ineligible.
  
  [ Read More ][168]
  Play Video play_arrow
* ## How to Prevent Skin Cancer
  
  In the latest episode of “Future You,” NYU Langone dermatologist Jennifer Stein, MD, PhD,
  discusses melanoma risk factors, the best sun protection, and more.
  
  [ Watch arrow_forward ][169]

## Our Mission

At NYU Langone Health, we’re redefining healthcare through our trifold mission: To care. To teach.
To discover. Our world-class services, top-tier medical education, and cutting-edge research are
what make us the nation’s top integrated academic health system.
* [John Golfinos, MD, J. Thomas Roland Jr., MD, and a resident perform surgery in an operating room
  at Tisch Hospital.]

  and a male student at the Anatomy Lab at NYU Grossman School of Medicine.]
  
  ### To Teach

  ### To Discover

For quality care in the US
For four years in a row, Vizient Inc. has ranked us as the nation’s top academic medical center.

## Most #1

Ranked specialties by *U.S. News & World Report*
In 2025, we ranked No. 1 in the US for neurology and neurosurgery; cardiology, heart, and vascular
surgery; pulmonology and lung surgery; and geriatrics.

## Our Mission

At NYU Langone Health, we’re redefining healthcare through our trifold mission: To care. To teach.
To discover. Our world-class services, top-tier medical education, and cutting-edge research are
what make us the nation’s top integrated academic health system.

### July is Vacation Time and UV Safety Month

It’s summertime - that means fun, sun, and vacations! Just because you are going through cancer
treatment doesn’t mean you can’t take a vacation. Watch the [Cancer Goes to the Beach][101] webinar
to get tips and resources to plan a safe and stress-free getaway. Wondering about [vacation while on
radiation treatment][102]? July is also UV Safety Month – learn all you need to know to [stay sun
safe][103] this summer.

### July is Vacation Time and UV Safety Month

It’s summertime - that means fun, sun, and vacations! Just because you are going through cancer
treatment doesn’t mean you can’t take a vacation. Watch the [Cancer Goes to the Beach][101] webinar
to get tips and resources to plan a safe and stress-free getaway. Wondering about [vacation while on
radiation treatment][102]? July is also UV Safety Month – learn all you need to know to [stay sun
safe][103] this summer.

# Shape the Future of Rare Disease at NORD's Breakthrough Summit®

**Washington, D.C. | October 25-27, 2026**

Register now for the NORD® Rare Diseases & Orphan Products Breakthrough Summit® — the leading event
for rare disease advocates, industry leaders, researchers, and policymakers.

[Register Today][246]
[NORD Summit Hero Image]

#### [Understanding New Medicaid Requirements][247]

Starting in 2027, community engagement or work requirements will apply to some Medicaid enrollees.
NORD has explainers for patients and caregivers, plus recommendations for state and federal
policymakers.

[LEARN MORE][248]

#### [Your Experience Can Shape the Future][249]

The Living Rare Study® is the first large-scale, long-term U.S. study tracking the evolving
experiences of individuals and caregivers impacted by rare diseases. Sharing your story can help
shape NORD programming, inform policy decisions, and improve access to resources that enhance
quality of life.

[JOIN THE STUDY][250]

#### [Rare Science on Demand][251]

Missed NORD's Rare Disease Scientific Symposium? Explore expert presentations, breakthrough
insights, and key research and regulatory discussions shaping the future of rare disease.

[ACCESS NOW][252]
[

### Patient Assistance Programs

][253]

Get help with access to medication, diagnostics, caregivers support, and other needs through NORD's
RareCare® programs.

[Get support][254]
[

### Rare Disease Database

][255]

Access our comprehensive database to view reports on more than 1,400 rare diseases.

[Search now][256]
[

### Rare Disease Centers of Excellence

][257]

NORD® Rare Disease Centers of Excellence are diagnosing and treating thousands of rare disease
patients.

[Learn More][258]
[

### IAMRARE^{®} Program

][259]

Assist researchers throughout the world better understand and treat rare diseases by enrolling in
our registry and sharing your experiences.

[Get involved][260]
[

### Living Rare Study®

][261]

Adults living with rare disease and caregivers can share their lived experiences to help drive
positive change.

[Participate Today][262]
[

### Help Advance Research

][263]

Discover how your rare experiences can help researchers and lead to a brighter future.

[Learn More][264]

# Delivering Therapy Where it Matters

**Developing Innovative Targeted Oncology Therapies and Commercializing RenovoCath^{®}, a Novel,
FDA-cleared Drug-Delivery Device**

[Our Therapy Platform][51]

## Standard of Care Pancreatic Cancer Treatment May be Limited in Effectiveness for Treating Tumors
## and is Often Accompanied by Debilitating Side Effects

Our Phase III TIGeR-PaC clinical trial is an ongoing randomized multi-center study evaluating the
proprietary TAMP™ (Trans-Arterial Micro-Perfusion) therapy platform for the treatment of locally
advanced pancreatic cancer (LAPC). RenovoRx’s first investigational drug-device combination oncology
product candidate uses the TAMP therapy platform enabled by the Company’s FDA-cleared RenovoCath
device and is designed for the intra-arterial administration of chemotherapy, gemcitabine (IAG).
RenovoCath is intended for the isolation of blood flow and delivery of fluids, including diagnostic
and/or therapeutic agents, such as chemotherapeutic drug infusion, to selected sites in the
peripheral vascular system. The study is comparing treatment with the combination oncology product
candidate, IAG, versus systemic (intravenous (IV)) administration of gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel.

[About Our Clinical Trial][52]
[Find a Clinical Site][53]

## **TAMP: Trans-Arterial Micro-Perfusion Therapy Platform**

Our patented TAMP therapy platform is designed to ensure targeted therapeutic delivery across the
arterial wall near the tumor site to bathe the target tumor, while potentially minimizing a
therapy’s toxicities versus systemic IV therapy. This novel approach to targeted treatment offers
the potential for increased safety and tolerance, as well as improved efficacy. RenovoCath, the
Company’s FDA-cleared device, enables the TAMP therapy platform. RenovoCath is indicated for
temporary vessel occlusion in applications including arteriography, preoperative occlusion, and
chemotherapeutic drug infusion.

combination oncology product candidate is currently being evaluated for the treatment of LAPC under
a U.S. investigational new drug application that is regulated by the FDA’s 21 CFR 312 pathway. The
combination product candidate, enabled the RenovoCath device, is currently under investigation and
has not been approved for commercial sale.

and RenovoCath as a stand-alone device.
